column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the sons of passing away” is rendered “all who are appointed to die.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֵשֶׁת־ חַיִל (“a woman of strength”) is rendered “a virtuous wife,” and “jewels” “rubies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the delight of her hands” is rendered “willingly works with her hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “she took it” is rendered “buys it,” and “the fruit of her hands” “her profits.”
Close to the Hebrew; “girds her loins” is rendered “girds herself.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַרְבַדִּים (“coverings”) is rendered “tapestry.”
Close to the Hebrew; “she laughs at the future day” is rendered “She shall rejoice in time to come.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the instruction of covenant loyalty” is rendered “the law of kindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “have done ability” is rendered “have done well.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְהֶבֶל (“a breath”) is rendered “is passing.”
